title: The Slow Vow
author: Paloma Galloway
blurb: Lior Ravensworth, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
